test_sort_index_basic: test the DataFrame.sort_index method for sorting rows by index labels in ascending or descending order
test_sort_index_multiindex: test the DataFrame.sort_index method with MultiIndex for sorting by specific levels and sort_remaining flag
test_sort_index_nan_handling: test the DataFrame.sort_index method with NaN index labels and na_position parameter for first or last placement
test_sort_index_inplace_axis: test the DataFrame.sort_index method with inplace=True and axis parameter for sorting rows or columns in place
test_sort_index_ignore_index: test the DataFrame.sort_index method with ignore_index=True to reset index to RangeIndex after sorting
test_sort_index_key_transform: test the DataFrame.sort_index method with key parameter for custom transformation functions like str.lower or negation
test_sort_index_categorical: test the DataFrame.sort_index method with CategoricalIndex for proper category order sorting
test_sort_index_stable_sort: test the DataFrame.sort_index method with kind='stable' for stable sorting preserving original order of equal elements
